title: Weighing the Hollow Throne reported 'No oil yet: the Ironbound keep casks at Cinderhall, and the palace has its own' even though I was carrying 'a cask of Ironbound cinder-oil' the entire time (from Lay-brother Emmet in the Hearthlands), and had already used that same cask as the burn-resolution fuel for two other hold-griefs (the Hunger Barn and the Drowned Nave). The throne's burn path did not recognize the item already in my pack.
where: Marrowgate / The Hollow Throne, 'weigh the doors of the seat'
